note: Which mob_skill_db entry each monster with skills uses, with rnd_force_min (every chance passes, every roll is lowest), and what the skill does. Each case spawns the monster at 'center' with monster skills off during the spawn, sets its HP to 'hp' percent of max HP (at least 1) and md->state.skillstate to 'state', with the player as target_id in attack, angry, chase and follow, else no target. The player is a level 99 Knight (melee build, nothing equipped) at center + (1, 0) with full HP and SP and no statuses. Entry states any and anytarget are read as idle and attack. The call runs at 2000 ms after the spawn: hp: mobskill_use(md, tick, -1). closedattacked: mobskill_event with BF_SHORT|BF_WEAPON and damage 100. longrangeattacked: BF_LONG|BF_WEAPON, damage 100. skillused: MSC_SKILLUSED | (event_skill << 16), damage 100, where event_skill is the entry's condition value, or Fire Bolt when it is 0. casttargeted: flag -1. groundattacked: MSC_SKILLUSED | (Fire Wall << 16), damage 100. damagedgt: BF_SHORT|BF_WEAPON with 'damage' one more than the condition value. rudeattacked: attacked_count 1, then mobskill_use(md, tick, -1). spawn: mobskill_use(md, tick, MSC_SPAWN). Results: 'used' is the index of the entry in the monster's skill list, or -1; 'skill' and 'level' come from that entry; 'target' is self, player, master, friend (another monster) or none, or cell with 'cell' the ground position from the center. 'cast_ms' is the cast timer's tick minus the tick read before the call, and 'cast_jitter' the milliseconds that passed during the call. A cast is then finished at once, as an instant cast. delay_battle_damage is off, so damage lands at once instead of through a timer. The player's perfect dodge (flee2) is set to 0 before each case, and a dead player is revived. 'effects', after the skill finished: 'player_hp_lost', 'player_dead', 'player_statuses' (SC_ values), 'player_moved' ([dx, dy] from its cell, or off_map), 'mob_gone' when the monster died or left the map, else 'mob_hp_change', 'mob_statuses', 'mob_moved' ([dx, dy] from the center), 'mob_mode' when the mode changed, 'mob_changed_to' when the monster changed into another ID; 'summoned' is the IDs of the other monsters on the map, sorted.
